title: 初級沉澱池設計
summary: 本課以沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支為主線，從懸浮固體進流、沉降速度與池深、表面溢流率、有效停留與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance through ten connected units, beginning with influent suspended-solids loading, settling velocity and depth, surface overflow rate, effective residence and bypass. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 懸浮固體進流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Influent suspended-solids loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 懸浮固體進流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Influent suspended-solids loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 初沉池去除可沉固體，負荷需以 TSS、沉降性與流量共同界定。
steps.instructionEn: Primary clarification targets settleable solids; define loading with TSS, settleability and flow.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
steps.failure: 只看濁度替代固體質量。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。
steps.failureEn: Turbidity is used as a substitute for solids mass. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「懸浮固體進流」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent suspended-solids loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.text: 只改變 C:180→210 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 360 變為 420 kg/d。用「懸浮固體進流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。

Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 沉降速度與池深：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Settling velocity and depth: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 沉降速度與池深 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Settling velocity and depth and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想粒子沉降提供量級，但污水絮凝讓粒徑與沉速沿途改變。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal settling gives scale, while flocculation changes particle size and velocity en route.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：粒子沉速=1.2 m/h；池深=3 m。模型 ts=H/vs，代入得到 2.5 h。適用邊界：單一離散粒子示例；實際絮凝與阻礙沉降不服從固定沉速。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Particle settling velocity=1.2 m/h; depth=3 m. Model ts=H/vs gives 2.5 h. Applicability: Single discrete-particle example; flocculent/hindered settling has no fixed velocity.
steps.failure: 把單一粒子速率當全部污泥行為。診斷與介入：用沉降曲線與有效水深核對，檢查短流及再懸浮。
steps.failureEn: One-particle velocity is taken as all sludge behavior. Diagnostic response: Check settling curves/effective depth and investigate bypass/resuspension.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「沉降速度與池深」的觀測點。用沉降柱畫界面高度與時間，不以單點判定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for settling velocity and depth. Plot settling-column interface height against time rather than using one point. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 沉降速度與池深
knowledge.text: 理想粒子沉降提供量級，但污水絮凝讓粒徑與沉速沿途改變。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal settling gives scale, while flocculation changes particle size and velocity en route.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 vs:1.2→0.8 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2.5 變為 3.75 h。用「沉降速度與池深」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only vs:1.2→0.8 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2.5 to 3.75 h. Explain the direction using settling velocity and depth, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
所有顆粒都有相同沉速。
理想粒子沉降提供量級，但污水絮凝讓粒徑與沉速沿途改變。
